en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a grand, multi-story classical building on a street corner. Leafy trees partially obscure the right side of the building. There is little traffic or people visible, and the architecture appears late 19th to early 20th century. Text on the card includes 'Göteborg' in the upper right, the publisher 'Axel Silfberg & Co., Göteborg' on the left, and the phrase 'Parti af Carl Gustafsgatan' at the bottom.
